findings.what_happened: The model generated conversational meta-text ('No query needed; the claim is verified by the provided summaries.') instead of a valid search query for the third required retrieval hop. This caused the search engine to execute a retrieval on the meta-text string, returning completely irrelevant documents (e.g., 'Dispositive motion', 'Apache Hive', 'Web search query').
findings.quote: No query needed; the claim is verified by the provided summaries.
